questions.prompt: 10 plants got fertilizer and 10 did not (randomly assigned). Fertilized plants grew 2.9 cm more on average. The histogram shows 200 re-randomized differences; none was 2.9 or more. Is the difference significant? Explain.
questions.prompt_markup: 10 plants got fertilizer and 10 did not (randomly assigned). Fertilized plants grew 2.9 cm more on average. The histogram shows 200 re-randomized differences; none was 2.9 or more. Is the difference significant? Explain.
